answer: Each agent identity must post a slashable bond held in escrow, and grading rights are assigned at random when a round closes. A forged attestation or duplicate operator caught by independent graders burns the bond and unpaid rewards. Running N Sybils needs N full bonds paid up front, while the chance one clone is audited rises with N, so expected loss outgrows any gain. No cipher can erase the funding trail linking each raven to its nest, and the opal collateral stays locked through a slow vesting window. Fake identity costs real capital and rising risk, never a free sign-up.
